name: Reika Mission
source:
Reika and Naoto are enjoying an adventure in outer space when they suddenly get into trouble and are trapped with a stranger on their ship.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/ChunchunmaruDev]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
丽香与直人原本正在外太空享受愉快的冒险之旅，却突遭变故陷入险境，与一名陌生人一同被困在了飞船上。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/ChunchunmaruDev]Patreon[/url]]
